verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents its own automation capability: 'Anyone can use Apps Script to automate Admin console tasks in a web-based, low-code environment.' Automatic user provisioning also syncs account changes to third-party apps without manual action. However, nothing shows user-defined automations running autonomously in the background, such as triggers, schedules or agent-driven workflows, and the evidence is admin-scoped rather than aimed at AI-native users. missing for 10: evidence of scheduled or event-triggered background execution, AI or agentic automation (e.g., Gemini-driven workflows), automation beyond Admin console tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
